speaker: ahaziah
text: Go inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I will recover from this injury.
name: Ahaziah

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: Go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria and ask them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are on your way to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron?’
name: The angel of the LORD

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘You will not get up from the bed on which you are lying. You will surely die.’
name: The angel of the LORD

speaker: ahaziah
text: Why have you returned?
name: Ahaziah

speaker: ahaziah-messengers
text: A man came up to meet us and said, ‘Go back to the king who sent you and tell him that this is what the LORD says: Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are sending these men to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not get up from the bed on which you are lying. You will surely die.’
name: Ahaziah's messengers

speaker: ahaziah
text: What sort of man came up to meet you and spoke these words to you?
name: Ahaziah

speaker: ahaziah-messengers
text: He was a hairy man,
name: Ahaziah's messengers

speaker: ahaziah-messengers
text: with a leather belt around his waist.
name: Ahaziah's messengers

speaker: ahaziah
text: It was Elijah the Tishbite,
name: Ahaziah

speaker: captain-1
text: Man of God, the king declares, ‘Come down!’
name: The first captain

speaker: elijah
text: If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men.
name: Elijah

speaker: captain-2
text: Man of God, the king declares, ‘Come down at once!’
name: The second captain

speaker: elijah
text: If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men.
name: Elijah

speaker: captain-3
text: Man of God, may my life and the lives of these fifty servants please be precious in your sight.
name: The third captain

speaker: captain-3
text: Behold, fire has come down from heaven and consumed the first two captains of fifty, with all their men. But now may my life be precious in your sight.
name: The third captain

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: Go down with him. Do not be afraid of him.
name: The angel of the LORD

speaker: elijah
text: This is what the LORD says: Is there really no God in Israel for you to inquire of His word? Is that why you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not get up from the bed on which you are lying. You will surely die.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Please stay here, for the LORD has sent me on to Bethel.
name: Elijah

speaker: elisha
text: As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you.
name: Elisha

speaker: sons-of-prophets
text: Do you know that the LORD will take your master away from you today?
name: The sons of the prophets

speaker: elisha
text: Yes, I know,
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Do not speak of it.
name: Elisha

speaker: elijah
text: Please stay here, for the LORD has sent me on to Jericho.
name: Elijah

speaker: elisha
text: As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you.
name: Elisha

speaker: sons-of-prophets
text: Do you know that the LORD will take your master away from you today?
name: The sons of the prophets

speaker: elisha
text: Yes, I know,
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Do not speak of it.
name: Elisha

speaker: elijah
text: Please stay here, for the LORD has sent me on to the Jordan.
name: Elijah

speaker: elisha
text: As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you.
name: Elisha

speaker: elijah
text: Tell me, what can I do for you before I am taken away from you?
name: Elijah

speaker: elisha
text: Please, let me inherit a double portion of your spirit,
name: Elisha

speaker: elijah
text: You have requested a difficult thing,
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Nevertheless, if you see me as I am taken from you, it will be yours. But if not, then it will not be so.
name: Elijah

speaker: elisha
text: My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Where now is the LORD, the God of Elijah?
name: Elisha

speaker: sons-of-prophets
text: The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.
name: The sons of the prophets

speaker: sons-of-prophets
text: Look now,
name: The sons of the prophets

speaker: sons-of-prophets
text: we your servants have fifty valiant men. Please let them go and search for your master. Perhaps the Spirit of the LORD has taken him up and put him on one of the mountains or in one of the valleys.
name: The sons of the prophets

speaker: elisha
text: Do not send them,
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Send them.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Didn’t I tell you not to go?
name: Elisha

speaker: men-of-jericho
text: Please note, our lord, that the city’s location is good, as you can see. But the water is bad and the land is unfruitful.
name: The men of Jericho

speaker: elisha
text: Bring me a new bowl,
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: and put some salt in it.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘I have healed this water. No longer will it cause death or unfruitfulness.’
name: Elisha

speaker: jeering-boys
text: Go up, you baldhead! Go up, you baldhead!
name: The jeering boys

speaker: joram
text: The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me to fight against Moab?
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: I will go,
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: I am like you, my people are your people, and my horses are your horses.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: Which way shall we go up?
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: joram
text: By way of the Desert of Edom,
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: joram
text: Alas,
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: joram
text: for the LORD has summoned these three kings to deliver them into the hand of Moab!
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: Is there no prophet of the LORD here? Let us inquire of the LORD through him.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: joram-servant
text: Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He used to pour water on the hands of Elijah.
name: A servant of the king

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: The word of the LORD is with him.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: elisha
text: What have we to do with each other? Go to the prophets of your father and of your mother!
name: Elisha

speaker: joram
text: No,
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: joram
text: for it is the LORD who has summoned these three kings to deliver them into the hand of Moab.
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: elisha
text: As surely as the LORD of Hosts lives, before whom I stand, were it not for my regard for the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would not look at you or acknowledge you.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: But now, bring me a harpist.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘Dig this valley full of ditches.’
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: For the LORD says, ‘You will not see wind or rain, but the valley will be filled with water, and you will drink—you and your cattle and your animals.’
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: This is a simple matter in the sight of the LORD, and He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: And you shall attack every fortified city and every city of importance. You shall cut down every good tree, stop up every spring, and ruin every good field with stones.
name: Elisha

speaker: moabites
text: This is blood!
name: The Moabites

speaker: moabites
text: The kings have clashed swords and slaughtered one another. Now to the plunder, Moab!
name: The Moabites

speaker: prophet-widow
text: Your servant, my husband, is dead, and you know that your servant feared the LORD. And now his creditor is coming to take my two children as his slaves!
name: A prophet's widow

speaker: elisha
text: How can I help you?
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Tell me, what do you have in the house?
name: Elisha

speaker: prophet-widow
text: Your servant has nothing in the house but a jar of oil.
name: A prophet's widow

speaker: elisha
text: Go,
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: borrow jars, even empty ones, from all your neighbors. Do not gather just a few.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Then go inside, shut the door behind you and your sons, and pour oil into all these jars, setting the full ones aside.
name: Elisha

speaker: prophet-widow
text: Bring me another.
name: A prophet's widow

speaker: widow-son
text: There are no more jars.
name: Her son

speaker: elisha
text: Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt. Then you and your sons can live on the remainder.
name: Elisha

speaker: shunammite
text: Behold, now I know that the one who often comes our way is a holy man of God.
name: The Shunammite woman

speaker: shunammite
text: Please let us make a small room upstairs and put in it a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp for him. Then when he comes to us, he can stay there.
name: The Shunammite woman

speaker: elisha
text: Call the Shunammite woman.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Now tell her, ‘Look, you have gone to all this trouble for us. What can we do for you? Can we speak on your behalf to the king or the commander of the army?’
name: Elisha

speaker: shunammite
text: I have a home among my own people,
name: The Shunammite woman

speaker: elisha
text: Then what should be done for her?
name: Elisha

speaker: gehazi
text: Well, she has no son,
name: Gehazi

speaker: gehazi
text: and her husband is old.
name: Gehazi

speaker: elisha
text: Call her,
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: At this time next year, you will hold a son in your arms.
name: Elisha

speaker: shunammite
text: No, my lord,
name: The Shunammite woman

speaker: shunammite
text: Do not lie to your maidservant, O man of God.
name: The Shunammite woman

speaker: shunammite-son
text: My head! My head!
name: The Shunammite's son

speaker: shunammite-husband
text: Carry him to his mother.
name: Her husband

speaker: shunammite
text: Please send me one of the servants and one of the donkeys, that I may go quickly to the man of God and return.
name: The Shunammite woman

speaker: shunammite-husband
text: Why would you go to him today?
name: Her husband

speaker: shunammite-husband
text: It is not a New Moon or a Sabbath.
name: Her husband

speaker: shunammite
text: Everything is all right,
name: The Shunammite woman

speaker: shunammite
text: Drive onward; do not slow the pace for me unless I tell you.
name: The Shunammite woman

speaker: elisha
text: Look, there is the Shunammite woman.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Please run out now to meet her and ask, ‘Are you all right? Is your husband all right? Is your child all right?’
name: Elisha

speaker: shunammite
text: Everything is all right.
name: The Shunammite woman

speaker: elisha
text: Leave her alone, for her soul is in deep distress, and the LORD has hidden it from me and has not told me.
name: Elisha

speaker: shunammite
text: Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me?’
name: The Shunammite woman

speaker: elisha
text: Tie up your garment, take my staff in your hand, and go! If you meet anyone, do not greet him, and if anyone greets you, do not answer him. Then lay my staff on the boy’s face.
name: Elisha

speaker: shunammite
text: As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you.
name: The Shunammite woman

speaker: gehazi
text: The boy has not awakened.
name: Gehazi

speaker: elisha
text: Call the Shunammite woman.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Pick up your son.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Put on the large pot and boil some stew for the sons of the prophets.
name: Elisha

speaker: sons-of-prophets
text: There is death in the pot, O man of God!
name: The sons of the prophets

speaker: elisha
text: Get some flour.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Pour it out for the people to eat.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Give it to the people to eat,
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha-servant
text: How am I to set twenty loaves before a hundred men?
name: Elisha's servant

speaker: elisha
text: Give it to the people to eat,
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: for this is what the LORD says: ‘They will eat and have some left over.’
name: Elisha

speaker: israelite-girl
text: If only my master would go to the prophet who is in Samaria, he would cure him of his leprosy.
name: The Israelite servant girl

speaker: aram-king
text: Go now,
name: The king of Aram

speaker: aram-king
text: and I will send you with a letter to the king of Israel.
name: The king of Aram

speaker: aram-king
text: With this letter I am sending my servant Naaman, so that you may cure him of his leprosy.
name: The king of Aram

speaker: joram
text: Am I God, killing and giving life, that this man expects me to cure a leper? Surely you can see that he is seeking a quarrel with me!
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: elisha
text: Why have you torn your clothes? Please let the man come to me, and he will know that there is a prophet in Israel.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha-messenger
text: Go and wash yourself seven times in the Jordan, and your flesh will be restored, and you will be clean.
name: Elisha's messenger

speaker: naaman
text: I thought that he would surely come out, stand and call on the name of the LORD his God, and wave his hand over the spot to cure my leprosy.
name: Naaman

speaker: naaman
text: Are not the Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Could I not have washed in them and been cleansed?
name: Naaman

speaker: naaman-servants
text: My father, if the prophet had told you to do some great thing, would you not have done it? How much more, then, when he tells you, ‘Wash and be cleansed’?
name: Naaman's servants

speaker: naaman
text: Now I know for sure that there is no God in all the earth except in Israel. So please accept a gift from your servant.
name: Naaman

speaker: elisha
text: As surely as the LORD lives, before whom I stand, I will not accept it.
name: Elisha

speaker: naaman
text: If you will not,
name: Naaman

speaker: naaman
text: please let me, your servant, be given as much soil as a pair of mules can carry. For your servant will never again make a burnt offering or a sacrifice to any other god but the LORD.
name: Naaman

speaker: naaman
text: Yet may the LORD forgive your servant this one thing: When my master goes into the temple of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my arm, and I bow down in the temple of Rimmon, may the LORD forgive your servant in this matter.
name: Naaman

speaker: elisha
text: Go in peace,
name: Elisha

speaker: gehazi
text: Look, my master has spared this Aramean, Naaman, while not accepting what he brought. As surely as the LORD lives, I will run after him and get something from him.
name: Gehazi

speaker: naaman
text: Is everything all right?
name: Naaman

speaker: gehazi
text: Everything is all right,
name: Gehazi

speaker: gehazi
text: My master has sent me to say, ‘I have just now discovered that two young men from the sons of the prophets have come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two sets of clothing.’
name: Gehazi

speaker: naaman
text: Please, take two talents.
name: Naaman

speaker: elisha
text: Gehazi, where have you been?
name: Elisha

speaker: gehazi
text: Your servant did not go anywhere,
name: Gehazi

speaker: elisha
text: Did not my spirit go with you when the man got down from his chariot to meet you? Is this the time to accept money and clothing, olive groves and vineyards, sheep and oxen, menservants and maidservants?
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Therefore, the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and your descendants forever!
name: Elisha

speaker: sons-of-prophets
text: Please take note that the place where we meet with you is too small for us.
name: The sons of the prophets

speaker: sons-of-prophets
text: Please let us go to the Jordan, where each of us can get a log so we can build ourselves a place to live there.
name: The sons of the prophets

speaker: elisha
text: Go,
name: Elisha

speaker: sons-of-prophets
text: Please come with your servants.
name: The sons of the prophets

speaker: elisha
text: I will come,
name: Elisha

speaker: sons-of-prophets
text: Oh, my master,
name: The sons of the prophets

speaker: sons-of-prophets
text: it was borrowed!
name: The sons of the prophets

speaker: elisha
text: Where did it fall?
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Lift it out,
name: Elisha

speaker: aram-king
text: My camp will be in such and such a place.
name: The king of Aram

speaker: elisha
text: Be careful passing by this place, for the Arameans are going down there.
name: Elisha

speaker: aram-king
text: Tell me, which one of us is on the side of the king of Israel?
name: The king of Aram

speaker: aram-servant
text: No one, my lord the king. For Elisha, the prophet in Israel, tells the king of Israel the very words you speak in your bedroom.
name: One of the king's servants

speaker: aram-king
text: Go and see where he is, that I may send men to capture him.
name: The king of Aram

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: Elisha is in Dothan,
name: An informant

speaker: elisha-servant
text: Oh, my master, what are we to do?
name: Elisha's servant

speaker: elisha
text: Do not be afraid,
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: O LORD, please open his eyes that he may see.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Please strike these people with blindness.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: This is not the way, and this is not the city. Follow me, and I will take you to the man you are seeking.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: O LORD, open the eyes of these men that they may see.
name: Elisha

speaker: joram
text: My father, shall I kill them? Shall I kill them?
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: elisha
text: Do not kill them,
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Would you kill those you have captured with your own sword or bow? Set food and water before them, that they may eat and drink and then return to their master.
name: Elisha

speaker: samaria-woman
text: Help me, my lord the king!
name: A woman of Samaria

speaker: joram
text: If the LORD does not help you, where can I find help for you? From the threshing floor or the winepress?
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: joram
text: What is the matter?
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: samaria-woman
text: This woman said to me, ‘Give up your son, that we may eat him, and tomorrow we will eat my son.’
name: A woman of Samaria

speaker: samaria-woman
text: So we boiled my son and ate him, and the next day I said to her, ‘Give up your son, that we may eat him.’ But she had hidden her son.
name: A woman of Samaria

speaker: joram
text: May God punish me, and ever so severely, if the head of Elisha son of Shaphat remains on his shoulders through this day!
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: elisha
text: Do you see how this murderer has sent someone to cut off my head? Look, when the messenger comes, shut the door to keep him out. Is not the sound of his master’s footsteps behind him?
name: Elisha

speaker: joram
text: This calamity is from the LORD. Why should I wait for the LORD any longer?
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: elisha
text: Hear the word of the LORD! This is what the LORD says: ‘About this time tomorrow at the gate of Samaria, a seah of fine flour will sell for a shekel, and two seahs of barley will sell for a shekel.’
name: Elisha

speaker: royal-officer
text: Look, even if the LORD were to make windows in heaven, could this really happen?
name: The king's officer

speaker: elisha
text: You will see it with your own eyes,
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: but you will not eat any of it.
name: Elisha

speaker: four-lepers
text: Why just sit here until we die?
name: The four lepers

speaker: four-lepers
text: If we say, ‘Let us go into the city,’ we will die there from the famine in the city; but if we sit here, we will also die. So come now, let us go over to the camp of the Arameans. If they let us live, we will live; if they kill us, we will die.
name: The four lepers

speaker: arameans
text: Look, the king of Israel must have hired the kings of the Hittites and Egyptians to attack us.
name: The Arameans

speaker: four-lepers
text: We are not doing what is right. Today is a day of good news. If we are silent and wait until morning light, our sin will overtake us. Now, therefore, let us go and tell the king’s household.
name: The four lepers

speaker: four-lepers
text: We went to the Aramean camp and no one was there—not a trace—only tethered horses and donkeys, and the tents were intact.
name: The four lepers

speaker: joram
text: Let me tell you what the Arameans have done to us. They know we are starving, so they have left the camp to hide in the field, thinking, ‘When they come out of the city, we will take them alive and enter the city.’
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: aram-servant
text: Please, have scouts take five of the horses that remain in the city. Their plight will be no worse than all the Israelites who are left here. You can see that all the Israelites here are doomed. So let us send them and find out.
name: One of the king's servants

speaker: joram
text: Go and see.
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: elisha
text: About this time tomorrow at the gate of Samaria, two seahs of barley will sell for a shekel, and a seah of fine flour will sell for a shekel.
name: Elisha

speaker: royal-officer
text: Look, even if the LORD were to make windows in heaven, could this really happen?
name: The king's officer

speaker: elisha
text: You will see it with your own eyes, but you will not eat any of it!
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Arise, you and your household; go and live as a foreigner wherever you can. For the LORD has decreed a seven-year famine, and it has already come to the land.
name: Elisha

speaker: joram
text: Please relate to me all the great things Elisha has done.
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: gehazi
text: My lord the king, this is the woman, and this is the son Elisha restored to life.
name: Gehazi

speaker: joram
text: Restore all that was hers, along with all the proceeds of the field from the day that she left the country until now.
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: The man of God has come here.
name: An informant

speaker: ben-hadad
text: Take a gift in your hand, go to meet the man of God, and inquire of the LORD through him, ‘Will I recover from this illness?’
name: Ben-hadad

speaker: hazael
text: Your son Ben-hadad king of Aram has sent me to ask, ‘Will I recover from this illness?’
name: Hazael

speaker: elisha
text: Go and tell him, ‘You will surely recover.’ But the LORD has shown me that in fact he will die.
name: Elisha

speaker: hazael
text: Why is my lord weeping?
name: Hazael

speaker: elisha
text: Because I know the evil you will do to the Israelites,
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: You will set fire to their fortresses, kill their young men with the sword, dash their little ones to pieces, and rip open their pregnant women.
name: Elisha

speaker: hazael
text: But how could your servant, a mere dog, do such a monstrous thing?
name: Hazael

speaker: elisha
text: The LORD has shown me that you will be king over Aram.
name: Elisha

speaker: ben-hadad
text: What did Elisha say to you?
name: Ben-hadad

speaker: hazael
text: He told me that you would surely recover.
name: Hazael

speaker: elisha
text: Tuck your cloak under your belt, take this flask of oil, and go to Ramoth-gilead.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: When you arrive, look for Jehu son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi. Go in, get him away from his companions, and take him to an inner room.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Then take the flask of oil, pour it on his head, and declare, ‘This is what the LORD says: I anoint you king over Israel.’ Then open the door and run. Do not delay!
name: Elisha

speaker: young-prophet
text: I have a message for you, commander,
name: The young prophet

speaker: jehu
text: For which of us?
name: Jehu

speaker: young-prophet
text: For you, commander,
name: The young prophet

speaker: young-prophet
text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anoint you king over the LORD’s people Israel.
name: The young prophet

speaker: young-prophet
text: And you are to strike down the house of your master Ahab, so that I may avenge the blood of My servants the prophets and the blood of all the servants of the LORD shed by the hand of Jezebel.
name: The young prophet

speaker: young-prophet
text: The whole house of Ahab will perish, and I will cut off from Ahab every male, both slave and free, in Israel.
name: The young prophet

speaker: young-prophet
text: I will make the house of Ahab like the houses of Jeroboam son of Nebat and Baasha son of Ahijah.
name: The young prophet

speaker: young-prophet
text: And on the plot of ground at Jezreel the dogs will devour Jezebel, and there will be no one to bury her.’
name: The young prophet

speaker: army-commanders
text: Is everything all right? Why did this madman come to you?
name: The army commanders

speaker: jehu
text: You know his kind and their babble,
name: Jehu

speaker: army-commanders
text: That is a lie!
name: The army commanders

speaker: army-commanders
text: Tell us now!
name: The army commanders

speaker: jehu
text: He talked to me about this and that, and he said, ‘This is what the LORD says: I anoint you king over Israel.’
name: Jehu

speaker: army-commanders
text: Jehu is king!
name: The army commanders

speaker: jehu
text: If you commanders wish to make me king, then do not let anyone escape from the city to go and tell it in Jezreel.
name: Jehu

speaker: watchman
text: I see a company of troops!
name: The watchman

speaker: joram
text: Choose a rider,
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: joram
text: Send him out to meet them and ask, ‘Have you come in peace?’
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: horseman-1
text: This is what the king asks: ‘Have you come in peace?’
name: The first horseman

speaker: jehu
text: What do you know about peace?
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Fall in behind me.
name: Jehu

speaker: watchman
text: The messenger reached them, but he is not coming back.
name: The watchman

speaker: horseman-2
text: This is what the king asks: ‘Have you come in peace?’
name: The second horseman

speaker: jehu
text: What do you know about peace?
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Fall in behind me.
name: Jehu

speaker: watchman
text: He reached them, but he is not coming back. And the charioteer is driving like Jehu son of Nimshi—he is driving like a madman!
name: The watchman

speaker: joram
text: Harness!
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: joram
text: Have you come in peace, Jehu?
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: jehu
text: How can there be peace,
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: as long as the idolatry and witchcraft of your mother Jezebel abound?
name: Jehu

speaker: joram
text: Treachery, Ahaziah!
name: Joram king of Israel

speaker: jehu
text: Pick him up and throw him into the field of Naboth the Jezreelite. For remember that when you and I were riding together behind his father Ahab, the LORD lifted up this burden against him:
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: ‘As surely as I saw the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons yesterday, declares the LORD, so will I repay you on this plot of ground, declares the LORD.’ Now then, according to the word of the LORD, pick him up and throw him on the plot of ground.
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Shoot him too!
name: Jehu

speaker: jezebel
text: Have you come in peace, O Zimri, murderer of your master?
name: Jezebel

speaker: jehu
text: Who is on my side? Who?
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Throw her down!
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Take care of this cursed woman,
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: and bury her, for she was the daughter of a king.
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: This is the word of the LORD, which He spoke through His servant Elijah the Tishbite: ‘On the plot of ground at Jezreel the dogs will devour the flesh of Jezebel.
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: And Jezebel’s body will lie like dung in the field on the plot of ground at Jezreel, so that no one can say: This is Jezebel.’
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: When this letter arrives, since your master’s sons are with you and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city and weaponry,
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: select the best and most worthy son of your master, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.
name: Jehu

speaker: samaria-officials
text: If two kings could not stand against him, how can we?
name: The officials of Samaria

speaker: samaria-officials
text: We are your servants, and we will do whatever you say. We will not make anyone king. Do whatever is good in your sight.
name: The officials of Samaria

speaker: jehu
text: If you are on my side, and if you will obey me, then bring the heads of your master’s sons to me at Jezreel by this time tomorrow.
name: Jehu

speaker: messenger
text: They have brought the heads of the sons of the king.
name: The messenger

speaker: jehu
text: Pile them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until morning.
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: You are innocent. It was I who conspired against my master and killed him. But who killed all these?
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Know, then, that not a word the LORD has spoken against the house of Ahab will fail, for the LORD has done what He promised through His servant Elijah.
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Who are you?
name: Jehu

speaker: ahaziah-relatives
text: We are relatives of Ahaziah,
name: Ahaziah's relatives

speaker: ahaziah-relatives
text: and we have come down to greet the sons of the king and of the queen mother.
name: Ahaziah's relatives

speaker: jehu
text: Take them alive.
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Is your heart as true to mine as my heart is to yours?
name: Jehu

speaker: jehonadab
text: It is!
name: Jehonadab son of Rechab

speaker: jehu
text: If it is,
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: give me your hand.
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD!
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him a lot.
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Now, therefore, summon to me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests. See that no one is missing, for I have a great sacrifice for Baal. Whoever is missing will not live.
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal.
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Bring out garments for all the servants of Baal.
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Look around to see that there are no servants of the LORD here among you—only servants of Baal.
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: If anyone allows one of the men I am delivering into your hands to escape, he will forfeit his life for theirs.
name: Jehu

speaker: jehu
text: Go in and kill them. Do not let anyone out.
name: Jehu

speaker: god
text: Because you have done well in carrying out what is right in My sight and have done to the house of Ahab all that was in My heart, four generations of your sons will sit on the throne of Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: jehoiada
text: This is what you are to do: A third of you who come on duty on the Sabbath shall guard the royal palace,
name: Jehoiada the priest

speaker: jehoiada
text: a third shall be at the gate of Sur, and a third at the gate behind the guards. You are to take turns guarding the temple—
name: Jehoiada the priest

speaker: jehoiada
text: the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD for the king.
name: Jehoiada the priest

speaker: jehoiada
text: You must surround the king with weapons in hand, and anyone who approaches the ranks must be put to death. You must stay close to the king wherever he goes.
name: Jehoiada the priest

speaker: israelites
text: Long live the king!
name: The people

speaker: athaliah
text: Treason! Treason!
name: Athaliah

speaker: jehoiada
text: Bring her out between the ranks, and put to the sword anyone who follows her.
name: Jehoiada the priest

speaker: jehoiada
text: She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.
name: Jehoiada the priest

speaker: joash
text: Collect all the money brought as sacred gifts into the house of the LORD—the census money, the money from vows, and the money brought voluntarily into the house of the LORD.
name: Joash

speaker: joash
text: Let every priest receive it from his constituency, and let it be used to repair any damage found in the temple.
name: Joash

speaker: joash
text: Why have you not repaired the damage to the temple? Now, therefore, take no more money from your constituency, but hand it over for the repair of the temple.
name: Joash

speaker: jehoash
text: My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!
name: Jehoash king of Israel

speaker: elisha
text: Take a bow and some arrows.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Put your hand on the bow.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Open the east window,
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Shoot!
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: This is the LORD’s arrow of victory, the arrow of victory over Aram, for you shall strike the Arameans in Aphek until you have put an end to them.
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Take the arrows!
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: Strike the ground!
name: Elisha

speaker: elisha
text: You should have struck the ground five or six times. Then you would have struck down Aram until you had put an end to it. But now you will strike down Aram only three times.
name: Elisha

speaker: god
text: Fathers must not be put to death for their children, and children must not be put to death for their fathers; each is to die for his own sin.
name: The LORD

speaker: amaziah
text: Come, let us meet face to face,
name: Amaziah

speaker: jehoash
text: A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle.
name: Jehoash king of Israel

speaker: jehoash
text: You have indeed defeated Edom, and your heart has become proud. Glory in that and stay at home. Why should you stir up trouble so that you fall—you and Judah with you?
name: Jehoash king of Israel

speaker: god
text: Four generations of your sons will sit on the throne of Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: ahaz
text: I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me from the hands of the kings of Aram and Israel, who are rising up against me.
name: Ahaz

speaker: ahaz
text: Offer on the great altar the morning burnt offering, the evening grain offering, and the king’s burnt offering and grain offering, as well as the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings of all the people of the land. Sprinkle on the altar all the blood of the burnt offerings and sacrifices. But I will use the bronze altar to seek guidance.
name: Ahaz

speaker: god
text: You shall not do this thing.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Turn from your wicked ways and keep My commandments and statutes, according to the entire Law that I commanded your fathers and delivered to you through My servants the prophets.
name: The LORD

speaker: assyrian-settlers
text: The peoples that you have removed and placed in the cities of Samaria do not know the requirements of the God of the land. Because of this, He has sent lions among them, which are indeed killing them off.
name: The settlers in Samaria

speaker: assyria-king
text: Send back one of the priests you carried off from Samaria, and have him go back to live there and teach the requirements of the God of the land.
name: The king of Assyria

speaker: god
text: Do not worship other gods or bow down to them; do not serve them or sacrifice to them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Instead, worship the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt with great power and an outstretched arm. You are to bow down to Him and offer sacrifices to Him.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And you must always be careful to observe the statutes, ordinances, laws, and commandments He wrote for you. Do not worship other gods.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not forget the covenant I have made with you. Do not worship other gods,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: but worship the LORD your God, and He will deliver you from the hands of all your enemies.
name: The LORD

speaker: hezekiah
text: I have done wrong; withdraw from me, and I will pay whatever you demand from me.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Tell Hezekiah that this is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: What is the basis of this confidence of yours?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: You claim to have a strategy and strength for war, but these are empty words. In whom are you now trusting, that you have rebelled against me?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Look now, you are trusting in Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff that will pierce the hand of anyone who leans on it. Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: But if you say to me, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ is He not the One whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem: ‘You must worship before this altar in Jerusalem’?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Now, therefore, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria. I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: For how can you repel a single officer among the least of my master’s servants when you depend on Egypt for chariots and horsemen?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: So now, was it apart from the LORD that I have come up against this place to destroy it? The LORD Himself said to me, ‘Go up against this land and destroy it.’
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: eliakim
text: Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Do not speak with us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall.
name: Eliakim, Shebna and Joah

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Has my master sent me to speak these words only to you and your master, and not to the men sitting on the wall, who are destined with you to eat their own dung and drink their own urine?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria!
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you; he cannot deliver you from my hand.
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the LORD when he says, ‘The LORD will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Do not listen to Hezekiah, for this is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then every one of you will eat from his own vine and his own fig tree, and drink water from his own cistern,
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: until I come and take you away to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and honey—so that you may live and not die. But do not listen to Hezekiah, for he misleads you when he says, ‘The LORD will deliver us.’
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Who among all the gods of these lands has delivered his land from my hand? How then can the LORD deliver Jerusalem from my hand?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: hezekiah
text: Do not answer him.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: This is what Hezekiah says: Today is a day of distress, rebuke, and disgrace; for children have come to the point of birth, but there is no strength to deliver them.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Perhaps the LORD your God will hear all the words of the Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to defy the living God, and He will rebuke him for the words that the LORD your God has heard. Therefore lift up a prayer for the remnant that still survives.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Tell your master that this is what the LORD says: ‘Do not be afraid of the words you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Behold, I will put a spirit in him so that he will hear a rumor and return to his own land, where I will cause him to fall by the sword.’
name: Isaiah

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: Look, he has set out to fight against you.
name: An informant

speaker: sennacherib
text: Give this message to Hezekiah king of Judah: ‘Do not let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you by saying that Jerusalem will not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
name: Sennacherib

speaker: sennacherib
text: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the other countries, devoting them to destruction. Will you then be spared?
name: Sennacherib

speaker: sennacherib
text: Did the gods of the nations destroyed by my fathers rescue those nations—the gods of Gozan, Haran, and Rezeph, and of the people of Eden in Telassar?
name: Sennacherib

speaker: sennacherib
text: Where are the kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?’
name: Sennacherib

speaker: hezekiah
text: O LORD, God of Israel, enthroned between the cherubim, You alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You made the heavens and the earth.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and hear; open Your eyes, O LORD, and see. Listen to the words that Sennacherib has sent to defy the living God.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Truly, O LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste these nations and their lands.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: They have cast their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods, but only wood and stone—the work of human hands.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: And now, O LORD our God, please save us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You alone, O LORD, are God.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: isaiah
text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I have heard your prayer concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: This is the word that the LORD has spoken against him: ‘The Virgin Daughter of Zion despises you and mocks you; the Daughter of Jerusalem shakes her head behind you.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Whom have you taunted and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Through your servants you have taunted the Lord, and you have said: “With my many chariots I have ascended to the heights of the mountains, to the remote peaks of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the finest of its cypresses. I have reached its farthest outposts, the densest of its forests.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: I have dug wells and drunk foreign waters. With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt.”
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Have you not heard? Long ago I ordained it; in days of old I planned it. Now I have brought it to pass, that you should crush fortified cities into piles of rubble.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Therefore their inhabitants, devoid of power, are dismayed and ashamed. They are like plants in the field, tender green shoots, grass on the rooftops, scorched before it is grown.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: But I know your sitting down, your going out and coming in, and your raging against Me.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Because your rage and arrogance against Me have reached My ears, I will put My hook in your nose and My bit in your mouth; I will send you back the way you came.’
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: And this will be a sign to you, O Hezekiah: This year you will eat what grows on its own, and in the second year what springs from the same. But in the third year you will sow and reap; you will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: And the surviving remnant of the house of Judah will again take root below and bear fruit above.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: For a remnant will go forth from Jerusalem, and survivors from Mount Zion. The zeal of the LORD of Hosts will accomplish this.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: So this is what the LORD says about the king of Assyria: ‘He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow into it. He will not come before it with a shield or build up a siege ramp against it.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: He will go back the way he came, and he will not enter this city,’ declares the LORD.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: ‘I will defend this city and save it for My own sake and for the sake of My servant David.’
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘Put your house in order, for you are about to die; you will not recover.’
name: Isaiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Please, O LORD, remember how I have walked before You faithfully and with wholehearted devotion; I have done what was good in Your sight.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: god
text: Go back and tell Hezekiah the leader of My people that this is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: ‘I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. I will surely heal you. On the third day from now you will go up to the house of the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will add fifteen years to your life. And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for My sake and for the sake of My servant David.’
name: The LORD

speaker: isaiah
text: Prepare a poultice of figs.
name: Isaiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: What will be the sign that the LORD will heal me and that I will go up to the house of the LORD on the third day?
name: Hezekiah

speaker: isaiah
text: This will be a sign to you from the LORD that He will do what He has promised: Would you like the shadow to go forward ten steps, or back ten steps?
name: Isaiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: It is easy for the shadow to lengthen ten steps,
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: but not for it to go back ten steps.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Where did those men come from, and what did they say to you?
name: Isaiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: They came from a distant land,
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: from Babylon.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: isaiah
text: What have they seen in your palace?
name: Isaiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: They have seen everything in my palace,
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Hear the word of the LORD:
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: The time will surely come when everything in your palace and all that your fathers have stored up until this day will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the LORD.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood, will be taken away to be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
name: Isaiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: The word of the LORD that you have spoken is good.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Will there not at least be peace and security in my lifetime?
name: Hezekiah

speaker: god
text: In Jerusalem I will put My Name.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will establish My Name forever.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will never again cause the feet of the Israelites to wander from the land that I gave to their fathers, if only they are careful to do all I have commanded them—the whole Law that My servant Moses commanded them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Since Manasseh king of Judah has committed all these abominations, acting more wickedly than the Amorites who preceded him, and with his idols has caused Judah to sin,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I am bringing such calamity upon Jerusalem and Judah that the news will reverberate in the ears of all who hear it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will stretch out over Jerusalem the measuring line used against Samaria and the plumb line used against the house of Ahab, and I will wipe out Jerusalem as one wipes out a bowl—wiping it and turning it upside down.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will forsake the remnant of My inheritance and deliver them into the hands of their enemies. And they will become plunder and spoil to all their enemies,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: because they have done evil in My sight and have provoked Me to anger from the day their fathers came out of Egypt until this day.’
name: The LORD

speaker: josiah
text: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest and have him count the money that has been brought into the house of the LORD, which the doorkeepers have collected from the people.
name: Josiah

speaker: josiah
text: And let them deliver it into the hands of the supervisors of those doing the work on the house of the LORD, who in turn are to give it to the workmen repairing the damages to the house of the LORD—
name: Josiah

speaker: josiah
text: to the carpenters, builders, and masons—to buy timber and dressed stone to repair the temple.
name: Josiah

speaker: josiah
text: But they need not account for the money put into their hands, since they work with integrity.
name: Josiah

speaker: hilkiah
text: I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD!
name: Hilkiah the high priest

speaker: shaphan
text: Your servants have paid out the money that was found in the temple and have put it into the hands of the workers and supervisors of the house of the LORD.
name: Shaphan the scribe

speaker: shaphan
text: Hilkiah the priest has given me a book.
name: Shaphan the scribe

speaker: josiah
text: Go and inquire of the LORD for me, for the people, and for all Judah concerning the words in this book that has been found. For great is the wrath of the LORD that burns against us because our fathers have not obeyed the words of this book by doing all that is written about us.
name: Josiah

speaker: huldah
text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Tell the man who sent you
name: Huldah the prophetess

speaker: huldah
text: that this is what the LORD says: I am about to bring calamity on this place and on its people, according to all the words of the book that the king of Judah has read,
name: Huldah the prophetess

speaker: huldah
text: because they have forsaken Me and burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke Me to anger with all the works of their hands. My wrath will be kindled against this place and will not be quenched.’
name: Huldah the prophetess

speaker: huldah
text: But as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, tell him that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘As for the words that you heard,
name: Huldah the prophetess

speaker: huldah
text: because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before the LORD when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its people, that they would become a desolation and a curse, and because you have torn your clothes and wept before Me, I have heard you,’ declares the LORD.
name: Huldah the prophetess

speaker: huldah
text: ‘Therefore I will indeed gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the calamity that I will bring on this place.’
name: Huldah the prophetess

speaker: josiah
text: What is this monument I see?
name: Josiah

speaker: men-of-bethel
text: It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and pronounced these things that you have done to the altar of Bethel.
name: The men of the city

speaker: josiah
text: Let him rest,
name: Josiah

speaker: josiah
text: Do not let anyone disturb his bones.
name: Josiah

speaker: josiah
text: Keep the Passover of the LORD your God, as it is written in this Book of the Covenant.
name: Josiah

speaker: god
text: I will remove Judah from My sight, just as I removed Israel. I will reject this city Jerusalem, which I chose, and the temple of which I said, ‘My Name shall be there.’
name: The LORD

speaker: gedaliah
text: Do not be afraid of the servants of the Chaldeans. Live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.
name: Gedaliah
